text: To improve the self-help book 'Journey to Success', the author should move beyond reiterating common knowledge by incorporating original insights and actionable advice. The organization needs to be restructured to ensure logical flow and coherence, replacing the current haphazard arrangement with a clear, step-by-step framework. Additionally, the inclusion of concrete examples will help illustrate concepts more effectively. For the physical production of the book, consider using transparent material to make windows, which could serve as a unique design element to highlight key takeaways or quotes within the text.
